title: Migrant caravan heads to US from Mexico after Democrats’ midterm win
html:
Migrant caravan heads to US from Mexico after Democrats’ midterm win

A migrant caravan of more than a thousand people is heading towards the US border from southern Mexico, amid renewed hopes of entering the US following the Democrats’ midterm win. President Donald Trump has threatened to double tariffs on Mexico if it does not stop the migrants.
summary: A migrant caravan of more than a thousand people is heading towards the US border from southern Mexico.
